owner_asks.action: Open https://www.theblock.co/contact, set inquiry type to 'Editorial / News Tip', fill first name, last name and your work email, paste the message below into the message box, tick the terms box and press Get in touch. Five fields, one paste, one button — the message is written out in full below, nothing to compose.
owner_asks.content:
News tip: Bitcoin's 500-day pre-halving buy window opens 29 November 2026, and all four completed windows went underwater before they paid.

I run btc500.net, which applies one fixed rule to a daily-close BTC/USD archive back to July 2011: buy exactly 500 days before a halving, sell exactly 500 days after.

What the four completed windows did (daily close): 29.90x (2012), 34.18x (2016), 11.67x (2020), 6.60x (2024). Every one of them closed below its entry price before the halving arrived — median low -11.7%, worst -83.65% (2011-11-22, from $14.07 to $2.30), median 84.5 days underwater. The multiple has fallen every cycle at 400-, 500- and 600-day spacings, so the decay is not an artefact of picking 500.

Full per-window table, method and machine-readable JSON, free to reuse with credit: https://btc500.net/bitcoin-500-day-cycle and https://btc500.net/data/500-day-cycles.json

The window opens in 10 days and I publish a $50,000 paper record tracked daily to the exit, drawdowns included.
